explain.say: Imagine someone far away decides you must pay extra for your books, and you get no say at all. How would you feel? In the 1760s, many people in Britain's 13 American colonies felt just like that. The board shows how anger grew into revolution.

faq.q: Why did Britain tax the American colonies?
faq.a: After the Seven Years' War ended in 1763, Britain had large debts and was paying soldiers to guard the colonies. Parliament decided the colonists should share the cost.
A 1765 British law that taxed printed paper in the colonies, like newspapers, legal documents and playing cards. Protests were so strong that it was cancelled in 1766.
asks: What did the Stamp Act tax?

faq.q: What does no taxation without representation mean?
faq.a: It means a government should not tax people who have no elected representatives to speak for them. The American colonists had no members in the British Parliament.

faq.q: What was the Boston Tea Party?
faq.a: On 16 December 1773, protesters, some disguised as Mohawk people, boarded ships in Boston harbour and dumped 342 chests of East India Company tea into the water to protest the Tea Act.
asks: Why did colonists dump tea in Boston?

faq.a: Many in Britain argued that Parliament represented everyone in the empire, even those who could not vote, and that colonists should pay for their own defence. Some British politicians, like Edmund Burke, sympathised with the colonists.
asks: What was Britain's side of the story?

facts: The Stamp Act was passed in 1765 and repealed in 1766.
At the Boston Tea Party on 16 December 1773, 342 chests of tea were dumped into the harbour.
The Declaration of Independence was adopted on 4 July 1776.

quiz.say: What does no taxation without representation mean?

options.show: No taxes without a say in government
options.say: No taxes without a say in government

quiz.why: Colonists accepted taxes in principle but wanted elected representatives.

wrong.1: They objected to taxes set without their voice, not to all taxes.
wrong.2: The slogan was about who decides taxes, not who pays them.

options.show: Protesters dumped tea in the harbour

options.show: People drank tea with the king
options.say: People drank tea with the king

options.show: Tea was made free for all
options.say: Tea was made free for all

quiz.why: In 1773 protesters threw 342 chests of tea into Boston harbour.

wrong.1: King George III was in Britain; this was a protest, not a party.
wrong.2: The protest was against a tax on tea, and the tea was destroyed.
